proof_summary: Assuming the asserted tail relation, the shifted values \(c_s=a_{3773+s}+1\) obey a Fibonacci recurrence; modular Fibonacci computation modulo \(195318521017\) then shows that \(a_{249580077006}\) and \(a_{249580077007}\) are both divisible by this modulus. Thus their gcd is greater than one, while equality of the asserted next value with the defining recurrence would force \((g-1)((a+b)/g-1)=0\); the alternative \((a+b)/g=1\) is impossible for positive \(a,b\) because \(g\le a<a+b\), giving a contradiction at \(n=249580077008\).
